pins.title: Burgundy Nails at Home: Clean Edges in 5 Steps
pins.sub: Dark polish shows every slip, so go slow

items.title: Gently push back cuticles
items.body: A clean edge makes dark colour look sharp.

items.title: Thin base, off the skin
items.body: Leave a hair-thin gap at the edges.
